title: frasera albicaulis var. modocensis
intro: Frasera albicaulis var. modocensis, commonly known as Modoc Indian paint root, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may aid in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Modoc Indian paint root include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Frasera albicaulis var. modocensis include iridoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
